tool_schemas.name: findNearbyStores
tool_schemas.description: Finds nearby Domino’s stores for the provided session using either a structured address (address_line1/city/region/postal_code/country_code) or latitude/longitude, persists the discovery results to the session, and returns up to limit stores (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither an address nor coordinates are provided, if required address components are missing, or if limit is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if session_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session is not accessible to the caller; may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream discovery quotas are exceeded.

session_id.description: Session ULID (dps_sess_01H8...) to associate discovery results and optionally set current_store_id.

address_line1.description: Street address line 1 used for store discovery.

address_line2.description: Street address line 2 used for store discovery.

postal_code.description: Postal/ZIP code used for store discovery.

country_code.description: ISO country code used for store discovery.

service_method.description: Desired service method to filter or tailor nearby store results.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return.

tool_schemas.name: getMenu
tool_schemas.description: Returns the menu for the given store_id and service_method, using a cached menu unless refresh=true forces a refetch from Domino’s. Raises NOT_FOUND if the store_id is unknown or no menu is available for that store/service_method combination; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an unsupported service_method or invalid store_id format; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the store is not accessible to the caller; may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream menu fetch quotas are exceeded.

store_id.description: Store ULID (dps_store_01H8...) to fetch the menu for.

service_method.description: Service method to select the appropriate store menu.

refresh.description: Whether to force-refresh and refetch the menu from Domino's instead of using a cached menu.

tool_schemas.name: createOrder
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new order in draft state for the given session_id, store_id, and service_method, stores the provided customer/delivery/payment metadata on the order, updates the session’s current_order_id, and returns the created order record. Raises NOT_FOUND if session_id or store_id do not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if service_method is invalid, if delivery_address is missing for delivery, or if provided fields fail schema validation; raises CONFLICT if the session has an active order that cannot be replaced; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session/store is not accessible to the caller.

session_id.description: Session ULID (dps_sess_01H8...) that owns this order and will be updated with current_order_id.

store_id.description: Store ULID (dps_store_01H8...) the order will be placed with.

customer.description: Customer details payload stored on the order (provider-shaped object).

delivery_address.description: Delivery address payload for delivery orders (provider-shaped object).

coupon_codes.description: List of coupon codes to apply to the order.

payment_method.description: Payment method to use when placing the order.

payment_payload.description: Payment details payload stored on the order (provider-shaped object).

tool_schemas.name: addItemToOrder
tool_schemas.description: Adds an order item (product_code, quantity, options, instructions) to the specified order and returns the updated order (including the newly created order_item_id). Raises NOT_FOUND if order_id does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if quantity is not a positive integer, if product_code is empty/invalid, or if options payload is invalid; raises CONFLICT if the order is not in a mutable state (e.g., already placed) or if the item cannot be added due to the order’s current lifecycle stage; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

order_id.description: Order ULID (dps_ord_01H8...) to add an item to.

product_code.description: Domino's product code/SKU for the menu item.

quantity.description: Quantity of the item to add.

tool_schemas.name: removeItemFromOrder
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified order_item_id from the given order_id and returns the updated order. Raises NOT_FOUND if the order_id does not exist or the order_item_id is not part of that order; raises CONFLICT if the order is not in a mutable state (e.g., already placed) and removals are refused; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid identifier formats; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

order_id.description: Order ULID (dps_ord_01H8...) that owns the item.

order_item_id.description: Order item ULID (dps_item_01H8...) to remove from the order.

tool_schemas.name: getOrderState
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current order referenced by the session’s current_order_id, including its workflow state (draft/validated/priced/placed) and any persisted provider response identifiers needed for downstream steps. Raises NOT_FOUND if session_id does not exist or the session has no current_order_id; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the session/order is not accessible to the caller; raises CONFLICT if the session points to an order that is no longer available.

session_id.description: Session ULID (dps_sess_01H8...) whose current_order_id will be used to fetch the order state.

tool_schemas.name: validateOrder
tool_schemas.description: Validates the order with Domino’s and persists the validation response/identifiers on the order, returning the updated order state and any validation messages. Raises NOT_FOUND if order_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the order is not in a state that can be validated (e.g., already placed) or required prerequisites are missing (e.g., delivery details for delivery); raises VALIDATION_ERROR if stored customer/address data is malformed; may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream validation quotas are exceeded; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: priceOrder
tool_schemas.description: Prices the order with Domino’s to compute totals, taxes, fees, discounts, and persists the pricing response on the order, returning the updated order with pricing details. Raises NOT_FOUND if order_id does not exist; raises CONFLICT if the order is not eligible to be priced (e.g., missing required validation prerequisites or already placed) or if the provider requires validation first; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the order data is malformed; may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream pricing quotas are exceeded; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: placeOrder
tool_schemas.description: Places the order with Domino’s using the provided payment_method and payment_payload, persists the provider’s placement identifiers/response, transitions the order to placed, and returns the updated order. Raises NOT_FOUND if order_id does not exist; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if payment_method is unsupported, payment_payload is missing/invalid, or the order fails provider placement requirements; raises CONFLICT if the order is not in a placeable state (e.g., not priced/validated as required, or already placed); may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream placement quotas are exceeded; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

order_id.description: ULID of the order to place.

payment_method.description: Payment method to use when placing the order.

payment_payload.description: Provider-specific payment details required to place the order (e.g., card token/last4, billing zip), stored on the order.

tool_schemas.name: trackOrder
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the latest tracking status for a placed order, persisting any provider tracking identifiers/responses needed for subsequent tracking calls. Raises NOT_FOUND if order_id does not exist or the order has no provider placement identifier to track; raises CONFLICT if the order has not been placed yet and therefore cannot be tracked; may raise RATE_LIMITED when upstream tracking quotas are exceeded; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the order is not accessible to the caller.

order_id.description: ULID of the order to track.

tool_schemas.name: createSession
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new ordering session in status=active, persists client_label/expires_at, and returns the created session. Refuses invalid expirations and returns UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to create sessions.

client_label.description: Optional caller-provided label to help identify the session (e.g., device/user reference).

expires_at.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp when the session should expire; if omitted, the server applies a default TTL.

tool_schemas.name: updateSession
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable session fields for an existing session and/or transitions its lifecycle state (active -> expired|revoked). Returns the updated session. Refuses invalid transitions and returns NOT_FOUND if session_id is unknown.

status.description: New session status. Only transitions from active->expired or active->revoked are allowed; expired/revoked are terminal.

current_store_id.description: Set or clear the session store context; use null to clear.

current_order_id.description: Set or clear the session order context; use null to clear.

tool_schemas.name: listStores
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted stores with optional filtering (provider, open status, geography, and text search) and cursor pagination. Returns matching store records ordered by updated_at desc. Refuses invalid pagination parameters.

is_open.description: If provided, filters to stores with the given open/closed flag.

near_latitude.description: Latitude to bias/filter results near a point (requires near_longitude).

near_longitude.description: Longitude to bias/filter results near a point (requires near_latitude).

radius_km.description: Optional radius in kilometers for near_* filtering; if omitted, server default is used.

q.description: Optional free-text search over store name/address fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of stores to return (default server-side).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; obtain from a previous listStores response.

tool_schemas.name: getStore
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted store by id and returns it. Raises NOT_FOUND if the store_id is unknown or not accessible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: listOrders
tool_schemas.description: Lists orders for a given session with optional status filtering and cursor pagination. Returns order records without removed items. Refuses access if the orders are not owned by the provided session context.

session_id.description: Session ULID (dps_sess_01H8...) that owns the orders to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default server-side).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; obtain from a previous listOrders response.

metadata.name: Domino's Pizza API Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Domino's store discovery results, store menus, and a session-scoped ordering workflow (draft order -> validated/priced -> placed -> tracked).
